request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and narrative, acoustic guitar, fiddle, piano, cello, gentle, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sarai had borne him no children yet
An Egyptian slave girl named Hagar
She gave her to Abram instead
To build a family through her

[Verse]
Hagar became pregnant with joy
But began to despise her mistress
Sarai cried out to the Lord
Abram said do as you wish

[Chorus]
Hagar the slave girl of Sarai
Where have you come from and where are you going
I am running away from my mistress
In the wilderness I am alone

[Pre-Chorus]
Found her by a spring of water
Beside the road to Shur
The angel of the Lord spoke
To the weary heart

[Chorus]
Hagar the slave girl of Sarai
Where have you come from and where are you going
I am running away from my mistress
In the wilderness I am alone

[Verse]
Go back to your mistress he said
Submit to her authority
I will greatly increase your descendants
Too many for counting to see

[Chorus]
Hagar the slave girl of Sarai
Where have you come from and where are you going
I am running away from my mistress
In the wilderness I am alone

[Bridge]
You are pregnant and will give birth
Name him Ishmael for God hears
He will be like a wild donkey
Living at odds with his kin

[Outro]
She called the Lord the God who sees me
Beer-lahai-roi by the well
Hagar bore Abram a son
And lived to tell the tale
